title: Reading Drill — A Calendar for Roof Maintenance
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Calendar for Roof Maintenance
passages.body:
**A** Several leaks at a college began in places covered by leaves. The property team checked the drainage channels every autumn but realised that nearby trees shed at different times.

**B** The team assigned each building a maintenance week according to local records. Buildings with trees directly above their roofs had an additional inspection after the first storm of the season.

**C** Caretakers also recorded whether each visit produced any repair work. After two years, the college lengthened checks at busy sites and reduced repeat visits at buildings rarely affected.
